problem: Normal admitted AI generation did not disable automatic screen locking; the QA outer start path also set the idle timer before the probe snapshotted it, so QA completion preserved true instead of the actual prior value.

behavior: Acquire an operation-owned native idle-timer lease for admitted normal AI operations and QA probe work.
Restore the previous idle-timer value on normal operation completion, including success, failure and user cancellation.
When lifecycle cleanup owns the operation, defer lease release until cancellation and runtime unload finish.
Use operation IDs so an old completion cannot release a newer lease.
Manual parameter generation and routing to model installation do not acquire the lease.
